title: Guardant Health
summary: US developer of liquid-biopsy tests for cancer.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Guardant Health sells blood-based genomic tests for cancer treatment selection and recurrence monitoring, and is seeking broad reimbursement for colorectal-cancer screening. Its tests analyse circulating tumour DNA, avoiding tissue biopsy. Reimbursement and clinical evidence are the commercial gatekeepers.

Technology Exposure

  • Liquid-biopsy cancer tests
  • Tumour profiling
  • Cancer screening

What To Watch

  • Reimbursement decisions
  • Clinical utility data
  • Path to profitability

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
